claims.evidence: No capacity marking or stamp visible on cylinder body or valve in the photo.
No origin label, import marking, or brand visible to confirm import status.

claims.claim: Recently tested and certified, no leak
claims.evidence: No certification sticker, inspection tag, or test report visible in the photo.
Valve is visible but no close-up showing manufacture date, brand, or absence of wear; general cylinder shows rust and scratches.

risks.risk: Actual cylinder capacity may not be 20kg
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped capacity/size marking on the cylinder neck or body.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the smallest common capacity (e.g., 12.5kg) until confirmed.

risks.risk: Cylinder may be empty, partially full, or completely empty of gas
risks.proof: Weighing scale photo/video showing gross weight, or a clear shot of the gas level gauge if present.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as empty (cylinder only, no gas value).

risks.risk: Valve may leak or fail pressure test
risks.proof: Video of a soapy-water leak test or a pressure gauge reading with the valve open.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as valve condition unknown/potentially faulty, requiring buyer-side testing.

risks.risk: No proof of recent certification or safety inspection
risks.proof: Photo of the certification sticker, inspection date stamp, or regulatory test tag on the cylinder.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as uncertified, needing re-inspection before refill.

risks.risk: Internal corrosion or structural weakening not visible externally
risks.proof: Hydrostatic test certificate or internal inspection report/photo.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as high-risk for internal rust, discounted for potential unsafe use.

risks.risk: Regulator and hose may not be included despite being commonly bundled
risks.proof: Photo showing regulator and hose included alongside the cylinder.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as cylinder only, accessories excluded.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the capacity stamp on the cylinder neck
Photo of certification/inspection sticker or tag with visible date
Video of soapy-water leak test on the valve
Photo or video of weighing the cylinder to estimate gas content
response.reason: The witness confirms it is an LPG cylinder, but capacity, fullness, certification, and valve condition are all unverified claims from the seller with no supporting visual proof, so it must be priced at worst case pending the listed evidence.
